description: This file defines a React component for a retro-themed, single-column Todo application with features like add, edit, toggle complete, delete, clear completed, and filtering. It includes localStorage persistence and accessibility features.

methods.name: loadTodos
methods.description: Loads the list of todos from localStorage, parsing JSON or returning an empty array on error.

methods.name: saveTodos
methods.description: Saves the current list of todos to localStorage as a JSON string.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds a new todo item with the current text input.

methods.name: handleKeyDownAdd
methods.description: Handles keydown event for the add input, triggers add on Enter.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completed state of a todo item by id.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a todo item by id.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Starts editing a todo item by id, focusing the input.

methods.name: submitEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited text or deletes the item if empty.

methods.name: onEditKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events during editing, submitting on Enter or cancelling on Escape.
